summary: Iteration 5 validates the global region switcher refactor (RegionContext) for D1 Custódia. Backend: 8/9 region-aware endpoint tests passed (CSV column-by-column test skipped because export has no 'Região' column, but isolation verified manually via curl: GRU=5, SP=4, Global=26 rows, no leakage). Frontend: switcher works on sidebar, switches data without reload, persists in localStorage, page subtitles display the region, /nova-custodia toast 'Selecione a Região' appears when empty. No JS errors during testing.

minor.issue: Region filter works (verified via row counts), but the CSV header does not contain a 'Região' column — users exporting a region-filtered file cannot tell from the file alone which region the data belongs to.

ui_bugs.issue: Problem statement claims wrapper data-testid='region-switcher' on desktop, but actual rendered element exposes data-testid='region-switcher-compact' (count=2, both are compact). Tests work because the compact variant is also used for desktop, but the documentation/data-testid plan diverges from implementation.

action_items: (Optional) Add a 'Região' column to /api/custodies/export/csv so exported files self-document the active region.
(Optional) Either add the data-testid='region-switcher' wrapper on the desktop sidebar variant or update the spec/playbook to reflect that 'region-switcher-compact' is used on both breakpoints.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is now 1079 lines — long overdue for a router-based split (auth.py, custodies.py, storage.py, exports.py).

/api/custodies/stats builds two different query shapes for ready_for_return depending on whether region is set (lines 662–675). Refactor to always use the $and form to simplify and reduce branch divergence.
/api/custodies/alerts also forks the ready_query when region is set (lines 720–728); same simplification opportunity.

POST /custodies still defaults model field region='São Paulo' (line 168). Coupled with the 400 validation, the default is harmless because the request body must explicitly include a valid value, but it is misleading — set default to None or remove.
Mongo indexes on 'region' should be created on app startup (referenced at line 1003); confirm with db.custodies.index_information() on first boot of a fresh DB to ensure idempotency.

success_rate.backend: 100% (8 passed, 1 skipped due to missing CSV column — non-blocking)

seed_data_creation: Created 2 TEST_ITER5_* custodies (SP + Guarulhos) via fixture; auto-resolved at end of run.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Region isolation across all endpoints verified. If main agent decides to add a Região column to the CSV export, re-run /app/backend/tests/test_region_iter5.py::test_csv_export_by_region (currently skipped). All tests are non-destructive (TEST_ prefix).
